sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Trophy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've got a hunting job for you, kid... There's this cockroach around here they call Reshala. I'm sure you've heard of him already, haven't you? Walks around with a golden pistol, showing it off like some kind of king. He's been interfering with me and my work for a long time, dragging his gang along with him. A lot of good people have ended up dead because of him. As for him, he's nothing but a coward, always hiding behind his guards. Help me get rid of him, and Tarkov will breathe a little easier. While you're at it, bring me his pistol. It'll make a fine gift for the Mechanic. Just be extremely careful. Good hunting, warrior."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and neutralize Reshala
- Hand over the found in raid Reshala's Golden TT-33 pistol to Jaeger

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Corrugated hose
"You've done a good deed. One less bastard walking on this land. Take this, a gift from me and Mechanic."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:

In this quest you have to kill Reshala and find his golden TT pistol in raid.
